newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Seoul stocks seen weakening on consolidation.
newsitem.headline: Seoul stocks seen weakening on consolidation.

text.p: Some primary blue chips were likely to be in the spotlight on the back of institutional and onshore fund buying, but brokers said the market in general would drift lower on consolidation throughout Tuesday.
"The market is expected to extend its consolidation. In the absence of either negative or positive factors, the market is likely to drift sideways," said Kim Dae-hee at LG Securities.
Brokers said corporate earnings for the first-half seemed to be worse than expected and the concerns would chill investors.
The composite stock index closed on Monday 1.49 points lower at 745.40. -- Yeom Yoon-jeong (822) 727 5647
